basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer from Seattle, Washington, with a passion for hardcore gaming and a penchant for venting about game mechanics. I've been a Tarkov player since its early days and have been on Reddit for nearly a decade sharing my thoughts and engaging in discussions. My interests include indie games, punk music (especially GG Allin), and naval strategy games. I'm usually online during evenings (Pacific Time) after work. I'm single, and my weekends are often reserved for long gaming sessions and Reddit browsing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 12 years. My gaming knowledge is extensive, having started with early PC games and evolving into a focus on tactical shooters and strategy games. I stay informed through game forums, developer updates, and community discussions.
